decisions.briefing: NASDAQ jumped +2.0% and the S&P 500 +1.4% in a clear risk-on session, so we deployed idle cash into three of the highest-scoring momentum candidates (QCOM, SMCI, LUNR) rather than sitting on dry powder. All three show MACD bullish crossovers with rising histograms and healthy (non-overbought) RSI readings; existing positions were left untouched since the market trend favors staying invested.

market_education.summary_en: Markets rallied broadly today with the NASDAQ leading gains at +2.0% and the S&P 500 up +1.4%, reflecting a risk-on shift in investor sentiment. Growth and momentum names outperformed, with many of the day's top movers showing bullish technical confirmation (MACD crossovers, rising momentum, price above key moving averages) rather than being driven by a single catalyst. This broad-based strength suggests improving risk appetite across sectors rather than a narrow, news-driven spike.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市普遍上揚,納斯達克指數領漲,升幅達2.0%,標普500指數亦上升1.4%,反映投資者風險偏好轉強。增長及動能股表現領先大市,當日多隻熱門股份均出現技術面利好訊號(包括MACD黃金交叉、動能上升、股價高於主要移動平均線),而非單一消息刺激所致。這種普遍性的強勢顯示市場風險胃納正在改善,而非個別板塊的短暫波動。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Momentum investing means buying stocks that are already showing strong upward price trends, based on the idea that stocks moving up tend to keep moving up in the short term. Today's broad rally (NASDAQ +2%) with multiple stocks showing bullish MACD and RSI signals is a classic momentum setup, which is why we deployed cash into the strongest-scoring names instead of holding back.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 動能投資是指買入已經呈現強勁上升趨勢的股票,其理念是股價上升的股票短期內傾向持續上升。今日大市普遍上揚(納指升2%),多隻股份同時出現MACD及RSI利好訊號,正是典型的動能投資時機,因此我們將現金部署至評分最高的股份,而非繼續持有現金觀望。
